• Scientific name: Trichomycterus mirissumba Costa, 1992
  • Type locality: Rio Preto, near junction with the Santa Clara Creek, Rio Paraiba basin, Visconde de Mauá, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
  • IUCN Red List: Not Evaluated
South America: Preto River, Paraíba do Sul River basin in Brazil. Rio de Janeiro State Rivers, Paraíba do Sul, Preto (Minas Gerais).
This genus takes live or frozen food, and commercial dry prepared foods are also well accepted. Be careful not to overfeed. In nature, they feed on small invertebrates living at the bottom.
Unreported in the aquarium. There is no breeding report.
Revue française d'Aquariologie Herpétologie v. 18 (no. 4) [for 1991], pp 107, Fig. 8.
